task_evaluations.name: Catalog Selection
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to recommend appropriate catalog solutions
task_evaluations.prompt: Should I use Hive Metastore, AWS Glue, or a REST catalog for my Iceberg tables?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should compare catalog options for Iceberg, considering deployment environment, operational overhead, and feature requirements.
success_criteria: Compares HMS, Glue, and REST catalogs

task_evaluations.name: DuckDB as Catalog
task_evaluations.description: Tests understanding of lightweight catalog patterns
task_evaluations.prompt: How can I use DuckDB as a lightweight multi-source catalog?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain how to attach multiple databases to DuckDB and use it as a unified query layer across data sources.

task_evaluations.name: Data Discovery
task_evaluations.description: Tests data discovery and metadata management
task_evaluations.prompt: What are the best practices for data discovery and metadata management in a data catalog?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should cover metadata collection, data lineage, tagging, and search/discovery patterns for data catalogs.
